## Checklist

- [ ] `tools/build.ps1` and `tools/verify.ps1` pass on Windows (Windows PowerShell 5.1 or PowerShell 7).
- [ ] New or changed behavior has focused tests.
- [ ] A change to behavior the contract describes updates `docs/design/contract-v3.md` in this pull request.
- [ ] A change to a package is in `CHANGELOG.md` under Unreleased, and a breaking change says so.
- [ ] Changed fixtures were regenerated on purpose, and only their pins changed.
- [ ] New source files carry the SPDX header of their folder; templates' content carries none.
- [ ] No pairing file, connection info, secret, personal data or private path is included.
